[{"proname":"bridge_attorney_step_to_matter_stage","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bridge_attorney_step_to_matter_stage(p_lane_key text, p_step_key text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case\n    when lower(coalesce(p_lane_key, '')) = 'bond' then 'finance'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(post.?registration|close.?out|final|handover|archive)' then 'post_registration'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(registered|registration)' then 'registration'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(lodg|deeds)' then 'lodgement'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(rates|levy|clearance|transfer.?duty|sars|guarantee)' then 'transfer_duty'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(document|search|fica|mandate|draft|sign|signature|authority)' then 'documents'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_step_key, '')) ~ '(instruction|open|intake|matter)' then 'instruction'\n    when lower(coalesce(p_lane_key, '')) = 'cancellation' then 'transfer_duty'\n    else 'documents'\n  end\n$function$\n","privileges":"{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}"},{"proname":"bridge_can_mutate_attorney_lane","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bridge_can_mutate_attorney_lane(p_transaction_id uuid, p_attorney_role text, p_capability text DEFAULT 'workflow'::text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_actor_id uuid := auth.uid();\n  v_role text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_attorney_role, '')));\n  v_capability text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_capability, 'workflow')));\nbegin\n  if p_transaction_id is null\n    or v_actor_id is null\n    or v_role not in ('transfer_attorney', 'bond_attorney', 'cancellation_attorney')\n    or v_capability not in ('workflow', 'documents', 'internal_notes', 'shared_updates') then\n    return false;\n  end if;\n\n  return exists (\n    select 1\n    from public.transaction_attorney_assignments assignment\n    where assignment.transaction_id = p_transaction_id\n      and coalesce(assignment.assignment_status, assignment.status, 'active') = 'active'\n      -- `transfer_and_bond` is one canonical appointment which covers both\n      -- lanes. Evaluate role/type independently so the transfer role stored on\n      -- that legacy shape does not erase its bond entitlement.\n      and case v_role\n        when 'transfer_attorney' then\n          lower(coalesce(assignment.attorney_role, '')) = 'transfer_attorney'\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.assignment_type, '')) in ('transfer', 'transfer_and_bond')\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.matter_type, '')) in ('transfer', 'transfer_and_bond')\n        when 'bond_attorney' then\n          lower(coalesce(assignment.attorney_role, '')) = 'bond_attorney'\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.assignment_type, '')) in ('bond', 'transfer_and_bond')\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.matter_type, '')) in ('bond', 'transfer_and_bond')\n        when 'cancellation_attorney' then\n          lower(coalesce(assignment.attorney_role, '')) = 'cancellation_attorney'\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.assignment_type, '')) in ('cancellation', 'bond_cancellation')\n          or lower(coalesce(assignment.matter_type, '')) in ('cancellation', 'bond_cancellation')\n        else false\n      end\n      and case v_capability\n        when 'workflow' then\n          coalesce(assignment.can_update_workflow_lane, true)\n          and v_actor_id in (\n            assignment.attorney_user_id,\n            assignment.primary_attorney_id,\n            assignment.assigned_user_id\n          )\n        when 'documents' then\n          coalesce(assignment.can_manage_documents, true)\n          and v_actor_id in (\n            assignment.attorney_user_id,\n            assignment.primary_attorney_id,\n            assignment.assigned_user_id,\n            assignment.secretary_id,\n            assignment.admin_handler_id\n          )\n        when 'internal_notes' then\n          coalesce(assignment.can_add_internal_notes, true)\n          and v_actor_id in (\n            assignment.attorney_user_id,\n            assignment.primary_attorney_id,\n            assignment.assigned_user_id\n          )\n        when 'shared_updates' then\n          coalesce(assignment.can_add_shared_updates, true)\n          and v_actor_id in (\n            assignment.attorney_user_id,\n            assignment.primary_attorney_id,\n            assignment.assigned_user_id\n          )\n        else false\n      end\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n","privileges":"{postgres=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}"},{"proname":"bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_label","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_label(p_stage text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case lower(coalesce(p_stage, ''))\n    when 'instruction' then 'Instruction'\n    when 'documents' then 'Documents'\n    when 'finance' then 'Finance'\n    when 'transfer_duty' then 'Transfer Duty'\n    when 'lodgement' then 'Lodgement'\n    when 'registration' then 'Registration'\n    when 'post_registration' then 'Post Registration'\n    else 'Instruction'\n  end\n$function$\n","privileges":"{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}"},{"proname":"bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_rank","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_rank(p_stage text)\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case lower(coalesce(p_stage, ''))\n    when 'instruction' then 10\n    when 'documents' then 20\n    when 'finance' then 30\n    when 'transfer_duty' then 40\n    when 'lodgement' then 50\n    when 'registration' then 60\n    when 'post_registration' then 70\n    else 10\n  end\n$function$\n","privileges":"{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}"},{"proname":"bridge_recompute_matter_lifecycle_from_attorney_workflows","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bridge_recompute_matter_lifecycle_from_attorney_workflows(p_transaction_id uuid, p_actor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_trigger_stage text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_trigger_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_transaction public.transactions%rowtype;\n  v_existing_stage text;\n  v_stage text;\n  v_trigger_rank integer;\n  v_existing_rank integer;\n  v_incomplete_in_trigger_stage boolean := false;\n  v_now timestamptz := now();\nbegin\n  select *\n  into v_transaction\n  from public.transactions\n  where id = p_transaction_id\n  for update;\n\n  if not found then\n    return null;\n  end if;\n\n  if lower(coalesce(v_transaction.lifecycle_state, '')) in ('registered', 'completed', 'archived', 'cancelled', 'canceled') then\n    return coalesce(\n      (select current_stage from public.transaction_lifecycle_workflows where transaction_id = p_transaction_id),\n      'post_registration'\n    );\n  end if;\n\n  select current_stage\n  into v_existing_stage\n  from public.transaction_lifecycle_workflows\n  where transaction_id = p_transaction_id;\n\n  v_stage := coalesce(nullif(p_trigger_stage, ''), v_existing_stage, 'instruction');\n\n  if nullif(p_trigger_stage, '') is not null and p_trigger_status = 'completed' then\n    select exists (\n      select 1\n      from public.transaction_subprocess_steps step\n      join public.transaction_subprocesses lane on lane.id = step.subprocess_id\n      where lane.transaction_id = p_transaction_id\n        and public.bridge_attorney_step_to_matter_stage(lane.process_type, step.step_key) = p_trigger_stage\n        and coalesce(step.status, 'not_started') not in ('completed', 'not_required')\n    )\n    into v_incomplete_in_trigger_stage;\n\n    if not v_incomplete_in_trigger_stage then\n      v_stage := public.bridge_next_matter_stage_after(p_trigger_stage);\n    end if;\n  end if;\n\n  v_trigger_rank := public.bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_rank(v_stage);\n  v_existing_rank := public.bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_rank(v_existing_stage);\n  if v_existing_stage is not null and v_existing_rank > v_trigger_rank then\n    v_stage := v_existing_stage;\n  end if;\n\n  insert into public.transaction_lifecycle_workflows (\n    transaction_id,\n    current_stage,\n    status,\n    last_updated_by,\n    last_updated_at,\n    updated_at\n  ) values (\n    p_transaction_id,\n    v_stage,\n    'active',\n    p_actor_id,\n    v_now,\n    v_now\n  )\n  on conflict (transaction_id) do update set\n    current_stage = excluded.current_stage,\n    status = excluded.status,\n    last_updated_by = excluded.last_updated_by,\n    last_updated_at = excluded.last_updated_at,\n    updated_at = excluded.updated_at;\n\n  update public.transactions\n  set\n    current_main_stage = v_stage,\n    current_sub_stage_summary = public.bridge_matter_lifecycle_stage_label(v_stage),\n    updated_at = v_now\n  where id = p_transaction_id\n    and lower(coalesce(lifecycle_state, 'active')) not in ('registered', 'completed', 'archived', 'cancelled', 'canceled');\n\n  return v_stage;\nend;\n$function$\n","privileges":"{postgres=X/postgres,anon=X/postgres,authenticated=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}"}]
